title: Initialize Scores
description: Assign equal probability (1/N) to all nodes as starting PageRank values.

title: Build Transition Matrix
description: Construct the probability distribution of moving from each node to its neighbors, handling dangling nodes (nodes with no outgoing edges).

title: Iterative Update
description: Repeatedly update each node's score by summing contributions from incoming neighbors: rank(u) = (1-d)/N + d * sum(rank(v)/out_degree(v)).

title: Apply Damping Factor
description: Use damping factor d (typically 0.85) to model random surfing behavior and prevent rank sinks.

title: Check Convergence
description: Monitor the change in scores between iterations until it falls below a threshold (e.g., 1e-6) or maximum iterations reached.
